verdict.rationale: Flagsmith does not document a native bulk-edit capability. Its Admin API covers everything the dashboard can do, and its CLI and MCP server let users and agents manage flags, segments and environments programmatically, so bulk changes are possible by scripting many individual calls. Segment overrides apply one change to all users in a segment, but that is targeting, not bulk management of many flags. Missing for 10: documented native bulk/batch endpoints or multi-select bulk actions, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and hands-on evidence of bulk changes across many flags.
